user.title: EZO Complete-ORP
user.description: Select the USB serial port of the Atlas Scientific EZO Complete-ORP. The integration probes the device with the `i` command and only continues if the reply contains ORP.

data_description.port: Prefer a /dev/serial/by-id/ path when listed — it stays stable if ttyUSB0 changes.
data_description.baudrate: Factory default is 9600. Only change this if you already sent Baud,<n> to the circuit.
data_description.name: Friendly name shown in Home Assistant.

usb_confirm.title: EZO Complete-ORP detected
usb_confirm.description: USB device {serial} on {port} (firmware {firmware}) answered as an ORP circuit.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EZO Complete-ORP
reconfigure.description: Change the serial port or baudrate. The device must still identify as ORP.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot open the serial port or the circuit did not answer
error.not_orp: This serial device is not an Atlas EZO ORP circuit
error.unknown: Unexpected error while probing the device

abort.already_configured: This EZO Complete-ORP is already configured
abort.not_orp: This USB device is not an Atlas EZO ORP circuit
abort.cannot_connect: Cannot talk to the USB serial device
abort.wrong_device: This is not the same EZO Complete-ORP

data_description.update_interval: Used to refresh diagnostics, and to send R when continuous mode is off.
data_description.continuous_on_start: Recommended. The circuit streams ORP readings by itself.
data_description.continuous_interval: Period sent as C,<n> after connect when continuous mode is enabled.

send_command.name: Send command
send_command.description: Send a raw EZO UART command (without the trailing CR).

command.name: Command
command.description: ASCII command, for example R or Status.

factory_reset.name: Factory reset
factory_reset.description: Restore factory defaults. confirm must be true.

confirm.name: Confirm
confirm.description: Must be true to execute the reset.

export_calibration.name: Export calibration
export_calibration.description: Read the calibration dump (stored on the export diagnostics snapshot).

import_calibration.name: Import calibration
import_calibration.description: Write previously exported calibration lines back to the circuit.

not_connected.message: The EZO Complete-ORP is not connected

not_orp.message: The serial device is not an EZO ORP circuit
